    Syncing via —. Last pushed never.

    This device is out of step and cannot fix itself
    To add another device, press “Show this device’s code” and enter that code on the other device using “Enter code from other device”. That joins them to one profile.
    “Generate new sync code” does the opposite: it starts a separate cloud profile and this device stops sharing with your others. It is not how you link a device, and it cannot recover missing hours.
    —
    Scan or type this code on your other device. Keep this screen open until it connects.
    This code plus its secret is what your data is encrypted with. Type it into your own device only — never paste it into a chat, an email, or any assistant.
    Life XP first checks and decrypts the other profile. If the histories can be combined safely, this device keeps a Recovery copy, joins that cloud identity, and publishes the union. Neither cloud row is deleted.

    Use the verified cloud profile here?

    Life XP will preserve and verify this computer’s current copy in Recovery Center, re-check the cloud revision, and then switch this computer to the cloud profile.

    Cloud sync will stay off after this switch. Nothing will upload. Review the profile, then turn on Enable cloud sync when you are ready.

    Two backends: Supabase (if you configured the keys at the top of focus-hero.html) and jsonstorage.net (free public KV — no setup). Your data is encrypted locally with the sync code secret before upload on the public backend.

    Conditioning follows sessions where you turn on Workout Mode. It never changes your selected build, tasks, hours, rewards, or recorded focus data.

    How it worksTurn on Workout Mode beside the timer for a Focus or Stopwatch session. A marked session counts once that day at 20+ minutes. The first 3 rest days are protected; days 4-7 visibly decondition the hero; 8+ days show the out-of-shape form.
    Workout Mode is chosen per session—not by task. You can correct it later from Session History or a Battle Report.
